Patient Record 07
Ward C — Long Stay

Admitted after the incident at the old dig site. Refuses to sleep. Keeps drawing the same door.

When asked what is behind it, he only says: "It was opened. Not by us."

Recommended: transfer to isolation.

Note from Dr. Hale: two more staff missing this week. Do not staff Ward C alone.
